extraction_scope.bounded_scope_note: Worker-6 adjudication replaced automated mechanism locator placeholders with source-bounded claims; no figure digitization was needed for the gate because tabulated activity endpoints carry the quantitative values.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: β-peptide hydrophobicity is inversely associated with MIC in planktonic Candida assays; this is a structure-activity relationship, not a direct molecular target claim.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Correlation is source-supported; it is not promoted to a direct mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Cell-wall removal did not materially change β-peptide activity against C. albicans in the source spheroplast comparison, supporting membrane-disruption context only.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: β-peptides 1, 4, and 5 in C. albicans yeast/spheroplast assays
mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper references membrane disruption from prior work and uses cell-wall/spheroplast context here; no new direct membrane-disruption endpoint is curated as direct_mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: β-peptides show weak disruption of existing Candida biofilms but source-supported prevention of biofilm formation, with stronger prevention for more hydrophobic peptides.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: C. albicans, C. glabrata, C. parapsilosis, and C. tropicalis biofilm assays
mechanism_claims.limitations: Biofilm activity is phenotypic; the evidence is not a direct molecular mechanism.

mechanism_summary: Mechanism layer is publication-usable with cautions: source-supported structure-activity and phenotypic biofilm findings are retained, while membrane-disruption language is kept contextual and not promoted to direct_mechanism.
